Maricamp Animal Hospital is a full-service veterinary medical center providing advanced care for dogs and cats in Ocala, Florida. Our team offers wellness exams, diagnostics, dentistry, surgery, and urgent care under one roof.

From routine checkups to complex medical cases, we focus on clear communication, accurate diagnostics, and trusted veterinary guidance that helps pet owners make informed decisions about their pet’s health.

Services include: Wellness & preventive care, internal medicine, diagnostics, surgery, dentistry, urgent & same-day care, nutritional guidance, and senior pet support.

Your pet’s health is our priority. At Maricamp Animal Hospital, we provide veterinary care for each stage of life.
